notes: Identifier resolution: the strand brief supplied this as a seed with no identifier, noting that opencite keyword search did not return it. OpenAlex has no record under either title.search:AdaBrain-Bench or title.search:AdaBrain (count 0 for both, checked 2026-07-31), and the arXiv Atom API was rate-limited (HTTP 429). Resolved instead through the arXiv web search interface, https://arxiv.org/search/?searchtype=all&query=AdaBrain-Bench, which returned exactly one hit: arXiv:2507.09882. Confirmed by fetching the abs page and matching the title and the ten-author list against the brief. No DOI exists; OpenAlex has no work record, so doi is null and the arXiv abs page is the canonical URL. Licence read directly from the abs-license block on the arXiv abs page, which links http://arxiv.org/licenses/nonexclusive-distrib/1.0/ -- arXiv's default non-exclusive licence, verbatim link text 'view license'. That licence grants arXiv a distribution right and conveys none to third parties, so pdf_license is unknown, redistribution_ok is false, and no PDF is committed. source.md is a markitdown conversion of the v2 PDF (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.09882, 3.25 MB, retrieved 2026-07-31) retained as internal research notes under fair use. md_quality is rough: the PDF is single-column body text but every results table (Tables 2, 3, 4, 6, 7) shredded into partial and interleaved markdown tables with dataset names orphaned onto their own lines, and inline words lost their spacing throughout. All numbers quoted on the card were read against the shredded tables cell by cell and cross-checked against the surrounding prose where the prose repeats them. Figures 2, 3 and 5 are image-only and carry results (linear-probe vs full fine-tune, with/without pretraining, few-shot curves) that are not recoverable from the extraction; the card cites only the values the body text states in words. Version note: the abstract on the arXiv abs page differs in wording from the abstract printed in the v2 PDF.
